pk.context: 60 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: green and blue, opaque, delayed-release capsule

tell: Its capsules hold enteric-coated pellets designed to protect this SNRI from degradation.

clues.text: Well absorbed, and food does not affect peak concentration, though it marginally reduces the extent of absorption. More than 90% is bound to plasma proteins, and it is eliminated mainly by hepatic metabolism.
A hydrochloride salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 297.4. It is slightly soluble in water.
An NDA product in 20, 30 and 60 mg delayed-release capsules.

Boxed warning for suicidal thoughts and behavior in children, adolescents and young adults. Contraindicated with MAOIs such as linezolid or intravenous methylene blue; nausea and dizziness are common.
Major depressive disorder and generalized anxiety disorder, plus diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia and chronic musculoskeletal pain.
It selectively inhibits serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake, potentiating serotonergic and noradrenergic activity in the CNS. Its exact mechanism in humans is unknown.
The generic name begins with D and has ten letters.
